Before your colleagues use [Desk by Agentivity](/docs/desk/agentivity-desk/), someone sets it up in the Studio. The Studio guides you with a card, **Set up your Desk**.

## What you need

- A plan that includes the Desk: Pro or Business.
- The right to change the settings.

## The card Set up your Desk

The card is on the home page of the Studio, and always in **Administration** › **Desk**. It has four steps, ticked from the real state of your workspace:

1. **Publish a Solution to the Desk.** The button **Choose** opens **Administration** › **Desk**, where you choose which of your agents, teams and workflows your people may start. See [What a Solution is, and how to mark one](/docs/introduction/what-a-solution-is/).
2. **Publish a cockpit.** The button **Open Cockpits** opens the starting page of a department. See [Build a cockpit](/docs/desk/build-a-cockpit/).
3. **Invite someone on a Desk seat.** The button **Invite** opens **People**, with the invitation on a seat of the Desk. The person receives an e-mail to choose their password, with a button **Open my Desk**.
4. **See the Desk as they will.** The button **Open the Desk** shows the Desk as a person on a seat of the Desk sees it: only the Solutions published, and no way into the Studio.

The foot of the card says how many steps are left: each one is ticked as your workspace changes. When all are done, the card reads **Your Desk is set up**. To close the card, select **Close** (the cross) on the home page. In **Administration** › **Desk**, **Show on the home page again** brings it back.

## See the Desk as your colleagues will

Step 4 opens the Desk with a banner that says what the other person sees: only the Solutions published to the Desk, and no access to the Studio. Select **Back to my view** to go back to your own view.

## The first visit of your colleagues

The first time a person opens the Desk, a short tour starts with a card: **Welcome to the Desk of** *your company*. It says: "The Desk is your company's shared set of AI teams, ready to use and approved by your company.", then shows three steps: **You ask**, **They do the work**, **You follow**. Its two buttons are **Skip** and **Show me around**. The tour then stops at **Ask for work**, **Answer here**, **Your departments** (only if there are cockpits) and **Your conversations**, and counts them as "1 of 3", or of 4 with cockpits. **Skip** leaves it for good. To see it again, open the account menu and select **Getting started**.

## How to know it worked

The four steps are ticked, and the Desk seen as a colleague shows the Solution and the cockpit you published.
